## [§4.2.c] Storage unit example — "free month of storage" at $127

So, storage. In this business, um, I have a whole story around this. But I, uh, tell this in the book, so I'll- I'll give you the brief version of it. But in the first few months of me being in business, I was struggling a little bit. And so, the business owner across the street was a massive storage unit. And he ended up becoming a member of my gym because it was super convenient for him. And so, he asked me, you know, "Hey, how much time you got left to live?" And I was like, "Not that long." And so, he said, "Come for a ride with me." And, uh, he took me to his facility, and he said, uh, "How much does a free month of storage cost?" And I was like-... I don't know, free?" And he was like, "No, $127." And so as we walked in, he asked Judy, the front desk girl, he said, "How much does a free month of storage cost?" She was like, "$127." And he was like, "That's right." And so I was like, "How does this even work?" And he was like, "Okay, so you come in for a free month of storage." He's like, "What's the first thing you're gonna need?" And as he's walking me through the facility and he pauses, and I was like, "I don't know." And then he taps the lock on the door and I was like, "Oh, a lock." And he's like, "Right." He's like, "And you can't have any kind of lock because there's only one kind of lock that fits this door, the locks that I sell at the front." And he's like, "For $47." And I was like, "Oh, okay. Got it." And I was like, "So you make 47, people come in for the free..." I was like, "But where's the other, you know, whatever it is, 80 bucks?" He's like, "Good question." He's like, "Now that you have your lock, what else are you gonna need?" I was like, you know, I'm, I'm like, "I don't know."He's like, "Well, you probably need some boxes for all that stuff that you have, which I have conveniently here. You don't wanna go to another place down the street or have to order them on Amazon, wait for them to come, break them, box them, all this." He's like, "We have them right here available for you." And I was like, "Oh, right."He's like, "And we also have, uh, hand tow, uh, the, the hand trucks that you can use to move your stuff in and out at your convenience, for a fee." And I was like, "Oh, right." He's like, "You know, and, uh, this stuff's probably really valuable for you 'cause otherwise you'd just throw it away, but it's valuable enough that you pay to store it. Uh, we obviously guarantee up to $500 in damage. Uh, that could happen if there's a flood or anything should happen or theft, but if you want, you can have a million dollar storage fee for just an extra $10 a month."
